Zero-class service. Please do not book Care24.

Before booking, they call repeatedly and talk about how professional and reliable they are. Once you pay, everything changes. Calls are not answered, there are no callbacks, and no support when you actually need help.

The care managers—Pooja Yadav, Priyanka Yadav, and Afrida and two more which names I don't remember—were completely unhelpful. They keep saying I understand mam we are looking for nurses and will get back but no gain. No one took responsibility or provided solutions.

For the first two days, they charged ₹1000 per day. After that, the nurse Swapnali simply disappeared. After repeated  calling she said company send me on leave and when crosss checked with manager they said she is not responding. Since then, for the last four days, I have been continuously calling with no proper response. When someone does answer, they just say “no staff available” and disconnect. I had been assigned two nurses but both of them cancelled at 11th hour.

Mr Anand on the first person from care 24 promised experienced caretakers would come. Also confirmed that there won't be any problem with the caregiver if one doesn't come we can provide replacement. but instead care manager sends the profile of a very young girls, one of whose address verification was also failed and had no experience with no near by location. All three were from Thane Mumbai Central powai.

My mother has just undergone surgery, and I genuinely needed support during this critical time. Instead, Care24 wasted my money, my time, and played with my emotions.

This message is for the OWNER of Care24: please understand what your customers are actually going through because of your staff’s behavior. If this is the level of service you provide, it’s better to shut the company down than exploit people during medical emergencies.

Extremely disappointed and mentally exhausted. I really want my money back.

a few days later, the new person I hired didn't turn up. so called these people again.  some guy who picked up the phone remembered and asked what happened to the person you had organized. So told him if he was willing to send someone or no. Extremely rude this person told me, no i am not sending and don't call again....
May be it was one off thing may be not..perhaps they aren't that professional as they claim to be..not sure..just wanted to share and let others beware about my experience as at the end of the day we all go by reviews of others' experiences or word of mouth references.
